Hi Amira — great to hear from you. 3:00pm PT today works for me; I’ll send a calendar invite in a minute.

Short answers ahead of the call:
- Start date: yes, we can be flexible. Please mention the exact range you need on the call so we can align with hiring manager and payroll.
- DocuSign: the offer letter is prepared and attached (PDF). We typically initiate DocuSign after verbal acceptance on the call, but there’s a small internal routing step: legal signs off on any redlines before envelope creation — that can add 4–24 hours depending on the ask.

Attachment: Amira_Hasan_Offer_Junior_SWE_20270510.pdf (offer letter draft)

Agenda for the 3:00pm call
- Quick verbal walk-through of offer highlights
- Candidate questions (start date, PTO, relocation)
- Confirm whether candidate wants any clause redlined (equity vesting specifics or PTO accrual)
- If verbal acceptance, confirm DocuSign timing

See you soon,

- Prep two DocuSign envelopes behind the scenes: (A) standard offer (fast path), (B) offer with the single legal concession (short clause amendment) so we can route to legal only if candidate asks for it.

Agree with Laura — procedural note from my side:

- Payroll/tax: if candidate starts in mid-June, payroll team needs the final start date by EOD the business day after DocuSign completion to ensure benefits enrollment window.

Proposed next steps:
1) Jonas to take the call at 3:00 and get verbal confirmation.
2) If verbal accept, Laura to instruct HR to prepare onboarding packet and have payroll hold the tentative start window of June 14–21.
3) I’ll create the alternate clause text and ping Lauren for a ~2 hour TA review. If Lauren approves, we release envelope B immediately (still held) and send whichever envelope candidate chooses.

I’ll put the draft clause in the DocuSign comment when I create envelope B.
